preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.
The length of array a is between 1 and 50,000.
The magic number m is between 2 and 10^9.
Each element in array a is between 1 and 10^9.
The length of array b is between 1 and 50,000.
Each element in array b is between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'Yes' or 'No' to indicate if array a can be transformed into array b.

invariants.expression: sum(n + k) over all test cases <= 2 * 10^5
invariants.description: The total sum of lengths of arrays a and b over all test cases is at most 200,000.
